title: Anchoring subnanometric Cu4 clusters in graphitic-C3N5 for highly efficient CO2 photoreduction to ethanol
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, 18,613-619
DOI: 10.1039/D4EE02449D, Communication
Entian Cui, Yulian Lu, Xiu-Li Yang, Guojun Dong, Yajun Zhang, Yingpu Bi
We demonstrated a facile electrochemical treatment for in situ anchoring of Cu4 clusters in a graphitic C3N5 framework, leading to remarkable improvements of photocatalytic reactivity and selectivity towards CO2 reduction to ethanol.
